title: poa glauca var. crocata
intro: Poa glauca var. crocata, commonly known as Blue Grama Grass, is a type of perennial grass that is native to the Great Plains region of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Blue Grama Grass include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities.
